newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Investment fund SPDIT drives Tunis bourse.
newsitem.headline: Investment fund SPDIT drives Tunis bourse.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed up by 1.77 percent, boosted by investment fund SPDIT-SICAF, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 518.83 from 509.80 on Monday.
Total volume was 1.49 million dinars against 1.53 million dinars. Turnover on the first market was 1.328 million shares from 948,167 at the previous session.
Invesment fund SPDIT-SICAF was up 7.01 dinars to 20.7 dinars with 10,446 shares changing hands.

Cola and beer bottler SFBT gained 2.84 dinars to 98.08. Chemical firm ICF rose 1.46 dinars to 50.56. Insurance company ASTREE was up 1.08 dinars to 37.36. Chemical firm SPCD rose 1.02 dinars to 35.42 dinars.
UBCI bank fell 0.42 dinar to 47.58 dinars. BIAT bank declined 0.18 dinar to 36.02. BTEI bank slid 0.2 dinar to 23.8. ($1= 1.08 dinar)
